∀ (A : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} A V]
  (s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries.{u_2} (Submodule.{u_1, u_2} A V)),
  Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.head.{u_2} s₁) Bot.bot.{u_2} →
    Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.last.{u_2} s₁) Top.top.{u_2} →
      Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.head.{u_2} s₂) Bot.bot.{u_2} →
        Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.last.{u_2} s₂) Top.top.{u_2} → CompositionSeries.Equivalent.{u_2} s₁ s₂

∀ (A : Type u_1) (V : Type u_2) [inst : Ring.{u_1} A] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u_1, u_2} A V]
  (s₁ s₂ : CompositionSeries.{u_2} (Submodule.{u_1, u_2} A V)),
  Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.head.{u_2} s₁) Bot.bot.{u_2} →
    Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.last.{u_2} s₁) Top.top.{u_2} →
      Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.head.{u_2} s₂) Bot.bot.{u_2} →
        Eq.{u_2 + 1} (RelSeries.last.{u_2} s₂) Top.top.{u_2} →
          Exists.{1} fun σ =>
            ∀ (i : Fin (RelSeries.length.{u_2} s₁)),
              Nonempty.{u_2 + 1}
                (LinearEquiv.{u_1, u_1, u_2, u_2} (RingHom.id.{u_1} A) (Etingof.compositionFactor.{u_1, u_2} s₁ i)
                  (Etingof.compositionFactor.{u_1, u_2} s₂ (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} σ i)))
